Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，Both parts refer to time, so using them together is redundant; the shorter time expression is natural in narration. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在靠墓地的家：住在靠近墓地的家里，A continuing living situation does not take completed-action 了; use 住在 before the location, and 靠近 means “near.” [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，跟 expresses doing something together as equal participants, while 带着 shows that the mother takes her child with her. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，Put 了 after the directional complement 到: 搬到 + 了 shows that the move was completed. [teacher rule: le_placement]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，Use 另一个 for one additional city; 别的 is used to distinguish other people or things from the one already discussed. [teacher rule: bieren]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，Meng子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other child has appeared, so use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence. [rule: redundancy_delete]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得没有钱，The same person is already the subject of the sentence, so use zero form rather than repeat the name within the same sentence. [rule: redundancy_delete]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，Every day describes a routine, so the verb takes the zero particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代和的时候同用重复，按教师标准应改为在古代。
住在表示居住地点，不能说住了在；靠近墓地的家里也是正确表达。
跟孩子搬家可以自然地表示母亲和孩子一起搬家，不是错误。
方向补语到后面应接了，搬到了的了位置正确。
这里应说另外一个或另一个城市，不能用别一个城市。
孩子在这里指代不够清楚；他能清楚指回刚提到的孟子。
孟母已是同一句的主语，害得后可用零指代而不重复姓名。
每天通常可用零标记，但这里句末了也可表示五岁时开始形成这一习惯，并非必错。
